# Chrono

> Chrono is a free, lightweight iOS/iPadOS productivity app that puts tasks, Apple Calendar, Apple Reminders, a focus timer, home-screen widgets, and time insights onto one timeline. Built with SwiftUI. No account, no tracking, no data collection — everything stays on-device and syncs only through the user's own Apple Calendar and Reminders (EventKit).

> Chrono 是一款免费、轻量的 iPhone/iPad 效率 App，把任务、Apple 日历、提醒事项、专注计时、桌面小组件和时间洞察整合到同一条时间轴上。基于 SwiftUI 开发；无需账号、不追踪、不收集任何数据，所有内容保存在设备本地，仅通过用户自己的 Apple 日历和提醒事项（EventKit）同步。

## At a glance
- App name: Chrono (App Store listing copy also uses the name "ChronoTracker"; both refer to the same app)
- Developer: 雨辰 沈 (dinghao)
- Price: Free (免费)
- Category: Productivity / 效率
- Size: ~7.7 MB
- Age rating: 4+
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 17.0+), iPad (iPadOS 17.0+), Mac (macOS 14.0+, Apple silicon), Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 1.0+)
- Languages (8): English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Italian, Czech, Japanese
- Privacy: Data Not Collected — no analytics, no ads, no third-party tracking SDKs. On-device storage via App Group UserDefaults + Apple EventKit (Calendar & Reminders). Confirmed by the App Store "Data Not Collected" privacy label.
- Built with: SwiftUI, EventKit, WidgetKit, ActivityKit. Minimum iOS 17.

## What it does
- One timeline: tasks, calendar events, reminders, focus records, and statistics on a single chronological view. Supports all-day, point-in-time, ranged, and cross-day schedules.
- Two-way Apple sync: full read/write with Apple Calendar and Apple Reminders through EventKit — no duplicate data entry.
- Focus timer: start a focused-work session, then settle it into a quick record when done. An ActivityKit Live Activity shows on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island while a session is running.
- Home-screen widgets: configurable "Quick Timer" widgets in small and medium sizes, with palette options and widget-triggered focus sessions via `chrono://` deep links.
- Insights: duration, hourly distribution, and focus-time analytics to review where time goes.
- Customization: 3 themes (Light, Dracula, System) and 8 languages.

## Why it's different
Timeline-first: unlike list-based to-do apps or standalone timers, Chrono lays scheduled events, reminders, and focus records on the same time axis, so the whole day is visible at a glance. It is lightweight (~7.7 MB), native, private by default, and integrates with the system apps users already have (Apple Calendar, Reminders) instead of replacing them.
